This sorghum plot is small, only a piece of my land, and I grow it because sorghum does not need much water like maize. I have no money for fertilizer from the shop — the bag is too big for this small plot and too costly. I will put some manure from my goats like my father did, and I keep my own seed from last harvest like everyone here. My wife and I will weed it ourselves, and I intercrop it with pigeon pea so the soil stays good.
